applyTo: "src/**"

# Project Overview

This project is a HTTP web server, reverse proxy, content cache,
load balancer, TCP/UDP proxy server, and mail proxy server.

## Directory Structure

- `auto/`: Contains the project build configuration scripts.
- `src/`: Contains the source code of the project.

## Coding Standards

- New code should follow the existing coding style.
- Use 4 spaces for indentation.
- Lines should be 80 characters or less.
- Local variable declarations should sort from shortest to longest by type.
- Multi-line if/while/for statements should have the opening curly brace at
  the start of its own line.
- Multi-line if/while/for statements should break before the operator.
- Multi-line statements should break before the operator.
- case and default statements should be at the same indentation level as the
  switch.
- No trailing comma on enum declarations.
- No // style comments.
- The opening curly brace for function definitions be at the start of its own
  line.
- Function return type and qualifiers should be on the preceding line for
  function definitions.
